name: Multi-Step Data Processing
description: Demonstrates sequential steps with dependencies and data transformation

steps.name: Extract Main Topic
steps.description: Extract the main topic from the input

llmConfig.systemPrompt: You are a text analyzer. Extract and return only the main topic as a single phrase.
llmConfig.content: What is the main topic of this text: '${input}'

steps.name: Generate Outline
steps.description: Generate an outline for the extracted topic

llmConfig.systemPrompt: You are an expert organizer. Create a structured outline with 3-5 main points.

steps.name: Process Outline
steps.description: Process the outline into structured format

steps.name: Summarize Results
steps.description: Create a final summary of the processed data

llmConfig.systemPrompt: You are a summarizer. Create a concise summary based on the provided data.
